name: Solstice
author: withLogic
description: Solstice is a remake of the ZX Spectrum game Equinox. You control a droid with the mission to stabilize a nuclear mining complex under the attack of unknown entities. The droid has the ability to fly and shoot to destroy the enemies, to protect itself with a plasma shield and to pick items for accessing other areas. There are 8 areas to complete. Can you bring peace to the world and prevent nuclear winter?
